title: Molecular Property Prediction under Structural Shift with Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting molecular properties for compounds that differ structurally from labeled training molecules is important for drug discovery and materials design. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a promising approach through in-context learning, but their performance under structural shifts and the value of molecular comparisons in this setting remain underexplored. We study structural generalization in molecular property prediction and introduce MolPAIR (Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement), a framework that combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts without task-specific parameter updates. A global tabular foundation model (TFM) first predicts a query's property from labeled molecular examples. A second frozen TFM predicts differences in prediction errors between the query and labeled reference molecules, using these comparisons to refine the initial prediction. translated_title: 基于表格基础模型的结构偏移下分子性质预测
translated_abstract: 预测与带标签训练分子在结构上存在差异的化合物的分子性质，对药物发现和材料设计具有重要意义。表格基础模型通过上下文学习提供了一种有前景的方法，但其在结构偏移下的性能以及分子比较在该场景中的价值仍未得到充分探索。我们研究了分子性质预测中的结构泛化问题，并提出了 MolPAIR（分子对增强的上下文精炼框架），该框架结合了分子级别和分子对两种上下文，且无需任务特定的参数更新。一个全局表格基础模型（TFM）首先从带标签的分子示例中预测查询分子的性质。第二个冻结的表格基础模型则预测查询分子与带标签参考分子之间预测误差的差异，并利用这些比较来精炼初始预测。在 58 个 MoleculeACE 和 Polaris 任务上，CheMeleon rep（摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出MolPAIR框架，利用两个冻结的表格基础模型分别进行分子级别预测和分子对误差比较精炼，在无需任务特定参数更新的情况下显著提升了分子性质预测在结构偏移下的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: MolPAIR combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts using two frozen tabular foundation models, refining predictions via error-difference comparisons to improve molecular property prediction under structural shift without task-specific parameter updates.
